project.visitorDecision: Choose a sourced public South Texas landmark without entering Starbase restricted roads or assuming launch viewing permission; carry the selected mission to the national launch planner.
project.primaryAction: Choose a mapped candidate and verify City of Starbase beach/road orders and Cameron County park access before making a launch-day trip.

claims.subject: beach-road-orders
claims.limitation: Beach open at check time is not launch safety approval; notices can change.

claims.subject: island-park-ownership-and-address
claims.limitation: Admission, hours, parking and view unverified for a particular launch.

claims.subject: boat-ramp-location
claims.limitation: Historic station site location is not precise spectator viewing or current land access.

claims.subject: lighthouse-tour-hours
claims.limitation: Tour hours are not event-specific access and no rocket sightline confirmed.

claims.subject: unobstructed-visible-launch-from-each-point
claims.limitation: Straight bearing is not line-of-sight, trajectory, confirmed visibility or legal authorization.

decisionState.sourceOfTruth: /api/rocket-launch-usa uses signed Postgres LL2 snapshot, City of Starbase notice, NWS; pure lib/starbase-viewing.js + checked local places.json for visitor map fallback.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Static source-backed places survive both missing schedule and map tile outage; stale/failed access and weather show unknown rather than implying open or safe.

scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No driving to pad or claimed sightline.
